svg.title: Threat-model your dotfiles: what a stolen laptop actually gets
svg.desc: A laptop silhouette with its back panel removed, exposing a glowing SSH private-key file and a leaking cloud-credential token that drip onto a command-history tape, all framed by a faint grid of dotfiles. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Threat-model your dotfiles: what a stolen laptop actually gets”. A isometric lattice probed by 4 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 656461487.
